We need to get a lot of heavy damage to take down this slow but menacing foe.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 10 (Formerly, [[Pizza Party|Pizzeria]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Scout''' is an enemy that only appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It is a very troublesome foe due to its high health and speed for when it appears. ==Appearance== The '''Scout''' is a robot that resembles the Level 0 and Level 3 Default [[Scout]]. It has pale skin, grey torso, sleeves and cap, dark grey backpack, dark green pants and knee-pad, and black shoe. The '''Scout's''' face is torn off and is hanging from its head, with multiple other parts of its body also being torn off, most notably its left shoulder, part of its left arm and its right foot, all of them also reveal the '''Scout's''' endoskeleton and wires. On death, it will shake and flail its arms around, emit yellow sparks, and then power down, with the yellow lights on its backpack turning off. It also plays a powering down sound when it dies. ==Strategy== *Cheap towers with high DPS, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Brawler]] or multiple low Level [[Golden Scout]]s are recommended, as the '''Scout''' has quite high health. **More expensive towers like the [[Accelerator]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] can also be used, if you are able to afford them. *Towers that can slow down the '''Scout''', such as the [[Sledger]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can be quite helpful, as the '''Scout''' is fairly fast. **Do note that this is not possible when it first spawns, due to it being a [[Boss]] enemy. Most forms of stalling will either not affect it or be significantly weaker. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:PizzaPartyAnimatronicDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Scout''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpsePZPScout.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TDSHalloween2022Thumbnail.png|'''Scout''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HalloweenPI1.jpg|'''Scout''' on a promotional image. Tower Defense Simulator- Halloween 2022 Trailer|'''Scout''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexScout.png|'''Scout''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''31 October 2022''' - [[v1.4.2]] **'''Scout''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Scout's''' death animation sometimes breaks, causing it to keep playing its walking animation shortly after its death animation. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **Health increased from 300 to 400. **Speed increased from Average (3) to Above Average (3.5). **Now gives {{Money|400}} upon death. **{{Bug}} Appears twice in the [[Index]], one of them not loading in any model for the preview. *'''29 January 2025''' - [[v1.51.0]] **Cash given increased from {{Money|400}} to {{Money|500}} upon death. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer appears twice in the [[Index]]. ==Notes== {{PizzaParty|[[Ghost]]|Wave 8|Scout|Wave 10|[[Breaker2]]|Wave 12}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Scout}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
